title: TikTok Has Labeled 3 Billion AI Videos: Here Is What the Research Says They Miss
description: TikTok AI content labeling hit 3 billion videos July 10, but published research finds small overlay labels produce no statistically significant reduction in users sharing or believing synthetic content — and the platform remains linked to ByteDance, which operates under China's National Intelligence Law regardless of the 2026 US restructuring deal.
